name: LC-QuAD-derived English Answer-Set Consistency Benchmark
description: English benchmark subset derived from LC-QuAD-style question materials. The file contains 150 benchmark items, each with four semantically related natural-language questions (Q1-Q4) designed to probe equivalence, subset, and complement relations between answer sets.

distribution.name: LC-QuAD English benchmark TSV
distribution.description: 150 benchmark items adapted from LC-QuAD-style question pairs and decompositions.

recordSet.name: lcquad_en
recordSet.description: Rows from LC-QuAD.tsv. Each row contains one benchmark item with four related natural-language questions.

field.name: lcquad_en/Q3
field.description: Question expected to target a subset or constrained variant of Q1's answers.

field.name: lcquad_en/Q4
field.description: Complementary question paired with Q3 so that Q3 and Q4 partition or complete Q1 depending on the benchmark item.

rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation of large language models for consistency across semantically related question variants.
Analysis of answer-set equivalence, containment, and decomposition behavior in question answering.
Not recommended as a standalone training corpus for open-domain QA because it is small and evaluation-oriented.
rai:dataBiases: Coverage is inherited in part from LC-QuAD-style knowledge-base QA examples and may over-represent entities and relations that are well documented in Wikidata-like resources.
The English-only phrasing may favor models and prompting strategies optimized for English.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is intended for consistency analysis, not comprehensive factual QA evaluation.
Some intended semantic relations remain approximate because natural-language questions can be pragmatically ambiguous.
The subset is small, which limits fine-grained subgroup analysis.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The released file contains benchmark questions only and is not intended to include personal or sensitive user data.
rai:dataSocialImpact: This subset can support more reliable QA evaluation by exposing inconsistency under paraphrases and constrained rewrites. It should not be treated as a comprehensive measure of truthfulness, safety, or fairness.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: LC-QuAD subset curation
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: Source question materials were selected and normalized into Q1-Q4 columns for answer-set consistency evaluation.
